title: Kissed Peppery Italian Mozzarella Flatbread
description: A quick and delicious Italian flatbread featuring mozzarella balls and a peppery kick, perfect for a snack or light lunch. This pescatarian-friendly dish is made with double-rise bread and can be prepared in under an hour.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine yeast and warm water, stirring to dissolve the yeast.
Add flour, salt, sugar, and 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the bowl, mixing until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough on a floured surface for 5 minutes, until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with plastic wrap, and let it rise in a warm place for 30 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Punch down the dough and roll it out into a 1/4 inch thick circle.
Place the dough on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, and brush the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil over the dough.
Arrange the mozzarella balls on the dough, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Sprinkle pepper, garlic powder, and dried oregano over the mozzarella balls.
Bake the flatbread in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, until the crust is golden brown and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
